The named conduct is using plugins, add-ons, or other third-party tools/services to connect to the platform and related systems without written permission. The sentence does not restrict itself to third-party login. It also does not expressly name robots, crawlers, automated collection, or anonymous public HTML metadata.

icourse163.conclusion: Do not describe 5.2.7 as a categorical ban on human browsing or as only a login restriction. Applying its tools/services integration language to a bounded anonymous public-HTML metadata reader remains a scope interpretation; these clauses alone do not establish an explicit crawler prohibition or an express automated-aggregation grant.
